extracted.intended_audience: attorneys/agents registered to practice before the USPTO and individuals seeking reinstatement
extracted.subtask_description: A USPTO Office of Enrollment and Discipline decision on a petition for reinstatement to practice before the USPTO under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58; describes the documents considered and the deciding authority. Useful for practitioners preparing or responding to reinstatement petitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Jonathan G. Morton has filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The petition for reinstatement should be supported by an affidavit meeting the requirements of 37 C.F.R. § 11.58; the presence of such an affidavit is a documented part of the record considered by the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of review for reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to his eligibility for reinstatement, the Director ... has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decisions on reinstatement are based on the petition, any supporting affidavits, and all record information material to eligibility. Petitioners should ensure the record contains all relevant factual and legal information bearing on eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision authority — Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate. Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director (here evidenced by the Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline acting as Director) is the deciding official for reinstatement petitions; rulings are formalized by a signed decision granting or denying the petition.
